subject: general
question: Who is the Union Minister of Tourism, as of March 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**G Kishan Reddy**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct answer is G Kishan Reddy.
 
• **G Kishan Reddy** has been serving as the **Union Minister of Tourism since July 2021**.
 
• He is a member of the **Bharatiya Janata Party **(BJP) and represents **Secunderabad in the Lok Sabha**.
 
• Under his leadership, the **Ministry of Tourism** focuses on **promoting India** as a **holistic destination**, both domestically and internationally.
 
• The ministry also works on initiatives to **boost tourism **through **infrastructure development**, **digitalization**, and enhancing the **tourist experience**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Initiative
 Description
 
 
 
 

 **Incredible India**
 A global marketing campaign to promote India as a premier travel destination.
 
 

 **Swadesh Darshan**
 A scheme aimed at integrated development of theme-based tourist circuits.
 
 

 **PRASHAD**
 Pilgrimage Rejuvenation and Spiritual, Heritage Augmentation Drive aimed at enriching the religious tourism experience.
 
 

 **e-Visa**
 A facility to promote easy access for tourists to India, available for citizens of over 160 countries.
 
 

 **Adopt a Heritage**
 A public-private partnership model for the preservation and maintenance of India's cultural and heritage sites.
